name: elecnix-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by elecnix: gh-monitor, agent-identity, and skills-lock-autoinstall.

plugins.name: gh-monitor
plugins.description: Monitor GitHub pull requests in Claude Code by wrapping the gh monitor CLI.

plugins.name: agent-identity
plugins.description: Gives every Claude Code session a minted agent handle such as cc-swift-koala-42.

plugins.name: skills-lock-autoinstall
plugins.description: Auto-installs agent skills from an npx skills lock file (skills-lock.json) on session start.
